Job Description: Job Description Responsible for providing solid support of Networking Products that involve customer-specific tests for a release, product, and solution. This role requires to develop and maintain expertise on the products deployed within the Specific Customer Networks. The Candidate should have strong expertise in networking fundamentals, L2/L3 protocols and hands on experience in both manual & automation of multi-dimensional scaled solutions testing. What you will do: Designs limited enhancements, updates, and programming changes for portions and subsystems of systems software, including operating systems, compliers, networking, utilities, databases, and Internet-related tools. Analyzes design and determines coding, programming, and integration activities required based on specific objectives and established project guidelines. Executes and writes portions of testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned portion of application; identifies and debugs issues with code and suggests changes or improvements. Participates as a member of project team of other software systems engineers and internal and outsourced development partners to develop reliable, cost effective and high quality solutions for assigned systems portion or subsystem. Collaborates and communicates with internal and outsourced development partners regarding software systems design status, project progress, and issue resolution. What you need to bring: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electronics, Electrical or equivalent. Typically 5-8 years strong experience in networking with proven hands-on experience in Routing and Switching areas across eVPN-VxLAN, DCI, Aggregation, Collapsed core/Aggregation based NW deployment designs Experience with internet protocols: TCP, UDP, IPv4/IPv6 Knowledge and Skills: Internet Protocols: TCP, UDP, IPv4/IPv6 Domain Knowledge: Enterprise Campus and Data Centre Technologies and AI/ML Data Center Network Technologies Networking Protocols: BGP, OSPF/ISIS, ARP, VLANS, MPLS, L3VPN, MC-LAG, LACP, L2VPN, VPLS, Multicast, NGMVPN, EVPN-VXLAN, GRE, IPSec, NAT, HTTP, NetConf, Access Security/DHCP/Dot1x etc. Layer 2 technologies, Spanning Tree, LAG, MC-LAG, Virtual Chassis, CLOS Architecture, HA Design Concepts, EVPN Test Knowledge: Prepare Test Plans, Test Execution, Understanding of Complex Customer Networks. Automation: Proven experience in automated test execution, ability to debug automation failures, and narrow down software issues from test results and logs. Knowledge in Python/Pytest/Go or any other scripting language. Expertise in use of networking test equipment like Spirent and Ixia, including automation.. Strong written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language. Ability to effectively communicate design proposals and negotiate options. Job Description: What You'll Do: Design, develop, and test high-quality solutions for networking systems, with a focus on reliability and performance. Perform QA and solution testing using network routers, switches, and virtual networking environments. Drive end-to-end testing of networking solutions, identifying issues and contributing to effective resolution. Act as a subject matter expert, participating in architecture discussions and contributing to technical and architectural decisions with cross-functional stakeholders. Partner with Engineering Managers and other stakeholders to drive technical initiatives and solve customer problems. Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and industry advancements and apply relevant learnings to improve solutions. What You Need To Bring: B.Tech or M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field. Minimum 5-6 years of hands-on software development experience, with strong coding skills in Python and Unix environments. Strong networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing protocols, and virtual networking. Hands-on knowledge of QA/testing involving network routers and switches. Good understanding of software testing and networking systems, with the ability to troubleshoot and contribute to solution testing. Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders. Additional / Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with virtual networking technologies. Strong learning mindset with an interest in keeping up with the latest technologies and tooling. title: Associate, Quality Assurance, Regional Product Delivery
desc: Business Function Group Technology enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group Technology, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels. Responsibilities Collaborate with product owners and developers to design and execute comprehensive test strategies, applying product thinking to ensure high-quality user experiences. Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for web and mobile applications using Playwright and Appium. Develop robust and scalable automation scripts utilizing Java and TypeScript. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and rapid deployment. Analyze test results, identify defects, and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve issues. Participate in Agile ceremonies, contributing to sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Proven experience as a QA Engineer or in a similar software testing role within an Agile environment. Demonstrated product thinking mindset with a strong focus on end-user value and quality. Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks, specifically Playwright for web and Appium for mobile testing. Proficiency in programming and scripting, with strong hands-on experience in Java and TypeScript. Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins) and version control systems (e.g., Git). Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Location: Hyderabad - DTI Waverock SEZ Job: Technology Schedule: Regular Employee Status: Full time
